Set F1 Account Credentials

Source: R/auth.R
set_f1_auth.Rd

Since October 2026, F1 live timing data (accessed through FastF1) requires an F1 account. This function stores your credentials in the F1_USERNAME and F1_PASSWORD environment variables, which FastF1 reads. The values are always set for the current R session. Optionally they are also saved in your user .Renviron file so they are available in future sessions.

Only the password authentication method of FastF1 is supported.

Usage

set_f1_auth(username = NULL, password = NULL, persist = FALSE)

Arguments

username

F1 account email. If NULL, you are prompted (interactive sessions only).

password

F1 account password. If NULL, you are prompted without echo using askpass::askpass() (interactive sessions only).

persist

Whether to also save the credentials to your .Renviron file. Default FALSE. Note that password will be stored in plain text in your .Renviron file if persist = TRUE.

Value

invisibly TRUE

Details

With persist = TRUE the password is stored in plain text in your .Renviron file (located by R_ENVIRON_USER or ~/.Renviron). The file permissions are restricted to the current user where supported. On shared machines consider setting the variables another way.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  set_f1_auth()
}
